hebrewText: וְ/שָׁאֲלָ֨ה אִשָּׁ֤ה מִ/שְּׁכֶנְתָּ/הּ֙ וּ/מִ/גָּרַ֣ת בֵּיתָ֔/הּ כְּלֵי כֶ֛סֶף וּ/כְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּ/שְׂמָלֹ֑ת וְ/שַׂמְתֶּ֗ם עַל בְּנֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/עַל בְּנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֶת מִצְרָֽיִם

tokens.bdb: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand

(adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

tokens.bdb: a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen
properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
tokens.kjv: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.
